## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2013-03-11: Form-of TRA first filed as Exhibit 10.16 to the S-1
- 2013-06-19: IPO closed; TRA executed
- 2013-06-25: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.3 to the closing 8-K

#### Going-private transaction (TRA disposition not yet recovered)

- 2018-12-21: 8-K (not yet recovered) commences going-private process
- 2019-01-14: Schedule TO-I issuer self-tender filed
- 2019-02-11: Schedule 13E-3/A filed
- 2019-03-18: Form 25 filed (Nasdaq delisting)
- 2019-03-28: Form 15-12B filed (Exchange Act deregistration)

## Explanation

Truett-Hurst, Inc. executed this TRA on June 19, 2013 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, agreeing to pay 90% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future exchanges of H.D.D. LLC Units by the founder vehicles and family trusts (the Hurst Family Revocable Trust, Hambrecht Wine Group, the Dolan Family Trusts, the Carroll-Obremskey Family Revocable Trust, and individual members). The 90% rate is materially higher than the conventional 85% and is worth flagging at the cross-firm timeline stage. The TRA was last visible as in force in the December 31, 2018 10-Q. In early 2019 Truett-Hurst executed a going-private transaction (Schedule 13E-3, SC TO-I, Form 25 Nasdaq delisting, and Form 15-12B Exchange Act deregistration); those filings are not yet recovered in this directory and the TRA's final disposition (acceleration paid out, negotiated termination payment, or terminated for nominal value given the small footprint) cannot be inferred from the available record. Status is marked `Unknown` pending that retrieval. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
